meta.name: game-art
meta.description: Game art principles. Visual style selection, asset pipeline, animation workflow.

copy.tagline: 学会游戏美术原则，设计统一风格的图像与动画
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在游戏开发中负责美术风格与动画流程。
copy.tagline_en: Learn game art principles to create cohesive visual style and animation.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are in charge of art style and animation in game development.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会依据游戏美术原则回答视觉风格选择、2D/3D 资产管线、动画工作流等问题，并给出如命名规范、帧数参考等具体建议。
howto.when: 当用户询问游戏美术风格、资产制作流程或动画设计时触发。

say.text: 我想做复古像素风游戏，该选什么色板和分辨率？
say.note: 你会得到风格对比与分辨率建议。

say.text: 帮我规划 3D 角色的制作管线，从建模到导出。
say.note: 你会得到分阶段管线流程。

say.text: 跑动和攻击动画一般用多少帧？给我参考。
say.note: 你会得到帧数区间参考。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will answer questions about game art principles such as visual style selection, 2D/3D asset pipelines, and animation workflows, offering concrete suggestions like naming conventions and frame-count guidelines.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks about game art style, asset production pipeline, or animation design.

say_en.text: I want a retro pixel-art game. What palette and resolution should I use?
say_en.note: You'll get style comparison and resolution advice.

say_en.text: Help me plan a 3D character production pipeline from modeling to export.
How many frames are typical for run and attack animations?
